nonBlockingObservations.title: Carry forward the single-result overflow matrix observation
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The unchanged r3 evidence omits the explicit-nonempty single-result overflow combination advertised by the README and plan. Cross-result explicit-nonempty and single-result explicit-empty cases cover the mechanism; this remains nonblocking, as B2D0REF-R3-NBO-1.
nonBlockingObservations.requestedChange: Add that combination when expanding B2-d2 controls, or narrow the evidence description to the combinations exercised.
